findings.summary: Share AudioBuffer allocation and LabSound bus wiring between explicit buffer creation and encoded-file decoding.
Reuse the glTF renderable feature sets already parsed for PBR composition when assembling the mixed Standard-material mesh table.
Remove the unused string-literal compiler callback from the audio call context.
Keep engine-handle collection searches and observable transform writes on their dedicated lowering paths instead of the generalized plain-data path.
Reuse the existing bind-vertex stream for wheel-local glTF geometry instead of adding local position, normal, and tangent fields to every model vertex.
Reuse one constructor resource-kind set instead of allocating an identical set for every successful constructor parameter binding.
Keep compiler-owned billboard replay in one staged helper per backend and reset only the Dawn mesh-pipeline cache it invalidates.
Include imported clone outer transforms in the existing shadow-caster world fold instead of widening the CSM resource or adding Racer-specific shadow bounds.
Replace stale two-cascade adaptation claims and the obsolete test with the measured first-cascade, clone-aware contract.
